notes.title: OVERPASS™ is now available on Steam with a 20% launch discount!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34977922/271941cfe54c8d022c295176f9eb7162ed5990ae.png[/img]

Are you ready to take on the toughest challenges in off-road racing? To tame a mixture of nature's rough terrain and challenging man-made obstacles in a mix of vehicles from brands that ATV and UTV fans will love. 

Pure speed is not the name of the game as you battle against these extreme off-road environments. Master the physics of each vehicle and push them to their extreme, avoiding vehicle damage as you navigate natural and artificial obstacles as you aim to pick up the gold medal!

OVERPASS™ is available now on Steam with a 20% discount on the base game and the Deluxe Edition until March 23rd. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/970840/OVERPASS/
